Protocol Z - Frequencies / Biotrohn®, frequency generator

Protocol cds protocol emergency support

Evidence: Grade B (traditional_use)

Summary

Emergency support protocol using CDS for acute conditions and urgent wellness needs.

Indications

  • Frequencies / Biotrohn
  • Frequency generator

Steps

  1. Prepare emergency dose
  2. Follow acute protocol
  3. Monitor symptoms closely
  4. Seek medical attention
  5. Adjust protocol

Dosage

Emergency support protocol: 2 ml CDS in 100ml water, hourly as needed

Expected Outcomes

  • Emergency support
  • Acute resolution
  • Urgent wellness
  • Critical recovery

Monitoring

  • Monitor symptoms hourly
  • Watch for complications
  • Medical supervision
  • Track response
  • Adjust as needed

Frequency: Hourly as needed
